In the solution, a two-step iterative algorithm is developed to solve the vehicle–track interaction, which is the iterative solution between the vehicle–rail subsystem and the track slab system as shown in Figure 2 and the iterative solution for deriving the elastoplastic dynamics solution of the track slab system.
Thus, it is not suitable for vehicle–track interaction problems with large scales.
In Section 2, the modelling method for vehicle–track interaction analysis has been presented.
Moreover, the effect of track irregularities on the vehicle–track interaction is analysed.
This vehicle–track interaction model is established by the coupled matrix representations.
